title: The Role Of Assessments In A World Of AI
text:
Podcast
The Role Of Assessments In A World Of AI
In a recent episode of the "WhatWorks" podcast, Josh Bersin sat down with Andy Bradshaw, CEO of SHL, to explore the transformative potential of talent intelligence in today's business landscape.
Listen Now:
Tune in to learn how bringing together diverse talent insights, leveraging both talent assessments and AI, can unlock new opportunities and enhance the strategic impact of your HR initiatives.
August 28th 2024 | 22 min 30 sec |
Listen on Spotify
Hear Josh and Andy delve into the critical role of
psychometric assessments
and the importance of measuring the skills, capabilities and potential of people at work—and how integrating AI with validated assessment methods is shaping the future of
talent management
Josh highlights SHL’s evolution from a pioneer in psychometric assessments to a comprehensive Talent Intelligence company. The conversation explored the importance of breaking down silos to connect
talent data
from different HCM platforms, including assessment data, and the need to create a unified, actionable view of the workforce with real-time talent insights for leaders to make better people decisions and drive better outcomes.
You’ll also hear Andy underscore the value of using science-based assessments in pre-hire screening, job-fit analysis, development planning, development, and
succession planning
, with a particular focus on leadership assessment and the critical importance of context in evaluating effectiveness.

Josh Bersin
